title: BUY THIS SET! YOU WON'T BE DISAPPOINTED!!
body: I ordered this set last night and had them shipped overnight. It was actually delivered in under 24 hours! I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the entire kit! I've bought several different clipper sets in the past 6 years and this beats anything I've had or used. My little fur- babies include 2 Shizhus and 3 Shizhu/ Chihuahua mix. They usually each have a VERY loud drama-filled melt-down during their grooming, but NOT TODAY!😊 The clipper itself was very quiet and that went a long way to ease their fear! It has different length fine-tuned settings built-in.  It also included a fully charged battery and six different combs to choose the length of the cut I wanted. I chose a close cut that we call our "Spring/Summer cut". The clipper was powerful, easy to use, and cut through their long/thick hair like a hot knife thru butter!! It usually takes at least an hour each to trim Loretta and Bubby (the Shizhus) and around 45 minutes each for Max, Bailey, and Lady Bug (the Shizhu/Chihuahua mixes.) With these clippers I finished them all in just under 3 hours and the clippers still have 50% charge! The ceramic blades NEVER even got hot!! The ONLY issue I had was with the Paw Trimmers. They didn't work as well for me as the clippers. There were two interchangeable heads in the kit for the Paw Trimmers and there was what I call another "gear" (speed) I could use but even that just didn't seem to have the same power and ease to cut their paws. I ended up using the clippers and the EXTREMELY NICE scissors that came with set! Afterwards, I was able to (with the instruction card) easily take off the blade, clean, and oil it in the recommended areas and replace the blade before putting it on charge.  I WILL DEFINITELY BE GIVING A FIVE STAR REVIEW!!! If you're out there.... with one or more fur babies, you can't afford to have a personal groomer to trim them, and if you're like me and honestly have come to dread even the thought of putting your fur babies through another grooming session where they are terrorized by the loud rattling noise of the clipper that ends up pulling their hair and getting hot before you finish one pup, BUY THIS SET!!! title: Easy To Use for The First Time Cutting My Dogs Hair
body: After 15 years of taking our Maltipoo to the groomers, they told me that they did not want to cut our dogs hair anymore since he is now blind and becomes scared so easily. So, I needed to try to cut his hair on my own. Shame on them! I did a lot of reading and watching videos, and decided to give these clippers a go, and am so happy that I did. The first time I cut my dogs hair was the day after I received these clippers. I took my time, starting down the back, cutting just a small amount off at a time, starting with the large guards to get the feel of them and working my way down to the sized guard that was cutting the length that looked good for my dog. You can always cut a little more off, but you cannot add it back on. This oneisall Dog Clippers and Dog Paw Trimmer Kit, together with the information about them on this web page, had everything that I needed to obtain a pretty good cut for my first time. Even though I was going slow while learning, taking 2 to 3 hours of time, the clippers showed that the battery still had over 80 percent charge left when I was done. Just be sure to fully charge up the clippers and trimmer before using. At first, I was scared to try cutting my dogs hair myself, but I was also scared to cut my own hair. I have been doing that now for the last 2 years, so it was not hard for me to get the feel of these clippers fairly quick, as there is really not any difference in how the clippers work. The clippers have such a low noise level, that my dog was not bothered at all with the sound. The overall cutting of the body hair was actually pretty easy to do. The trimmers are going to take a little longer for me and the dog to get used to, as most dogs do not take too kindly with handling their paws very much, and it takes a bit of patience while learning to be very careful when trimming around the face, eyes, ears, genitals, and such using the trimmers and scissors, while learning how to keep the dog still for at least a few moments of time. Sometimes you need to just stop and take a break for yourself and the dog. There is really no reason to be in a hurry. The scissors and comb are great. You need to be sure to first give the dog a bath and be dried off, then get any knots out before using the clippers. The comb helped a lot with getting knots out, using it lightly and slowly from the top of the knot on down, until it is removed, and you can comb though it with no resistance. If necessary, cut it out. Once you can comb through all of the hair easily without running into any knots, then you are ready to start cutting and saving money with no more groomers. Be sure to keep the clippers and trimmers clean and well oiled, and you will want to buy some more clipper oil because these should last a long time. I can’t think of how this kit could be any better, other than maybe a pair of curved scissors. Read more Read less
